terms.definition: The amount of turn between two rays sharing a vertex.
terms.function: Measures how open or closed a turn is.
terms.whyItMatters: Angles measure the turns inside every shape.

terms.definition: The shared endpoint where the two rays meet.
terms.function: The corner point of the angle.
terms.whereItIs: The solid dot where the rays join.
terms.whyItMatters: The vertex is the pivot of the whole turn.

terms.definition: The unit for measuring a turn — 360° makes a full circle.
terms.function: A right angle is 90°, a straight angle is 180°.
terms.whereItIs: The number on the angle label.
terms.whyItMatters: Degrees turn open or closed into a number.

terms.definition: Names for angles by size: acute < 90°, right = 90°, obtuse > 90°.
terms.function: Sort angles into families at a glance.
terms.whereItIs: The category shown on the label.
terms.whyItMatters: Type names let you describe shapes instantly.
